_comment: Acts are derived, never saved: select the highest act whose predecessor gates pass. Conditions support min_classes, quests_completed, and accomplishment counts; empty means true. reached_two_classes is monotonic across consolidation. Act V is last, so ITS advance_when is the defined-but-unreachable one -- it names seal_resolved so the finale sequence has a single gate to read, and so a maxed save still lights every beat it owns.

beats.text: You've grown into a class of your own.
Liscor's gates opened for you at last.

acts.title: Make a Place for Yourself
acts.header: Act II -- Make a Place for Yourself

beats.text: Word of your errands is getting around town.
Krshia trusts you with more than gossip now.
The Watch knows to call on you when something's wrong.
Liscor is starting to know your face.
Something is moving in the dark beneath the city.
The warren below is cleared, and the thing in the dark is cut off from its congregation.

acts._comment: Act V gate (revised in fix round 1 by controller ruling): the seal report plus the two region terminals the pilgrimage does not imply. Transitivity covers the rest -- lattice_forge_rune implies spine_started and elevator_pass_stamped, lattice_witch_lore requires price_of_a_favor_reported, lattice_hedault_reading requires brothers_job_done, and Act V's descent ask requires all three lattice counters. Naming them here is what keeps riverfarm_owed and invrisil_squared from being STRANDED: a beat whose counter can only bank in an act the player has already left can never render (the act_iii defect). counted_among is deliberately NOT in the gate -- it is the seal's own closing line, relocated here because post_game banks at the first sleep AFTER the seal (sleep_beat.gd). SPOILER DISCIPLINE (act_v's rule, binding here since the reframe moved entry from post-game to the seal): journal.gd:639 renders PENDING beats in full, so every line below is visible mid-story and none may exceed the act title. the_reach_mapped re-copied 2026-07-27 -- it stated Act V's reveal. The five region beats are PRE-WAVE copy whose VISIBILITY, not text, this wave changed; each still names its chain's outcome while pending. That one is a render-policy call (hide unearned beats), not copy -- stripping specifics would gut the earned page. docs/VISUAL-LOG.md.
acts.title: What the Door Opened
acts.header: Act IV -- What the Door Opened

beats.text: The seal holds. Liscor counts you among its own.
The pantry door remembers being elsewhere again, and somewhere else remembers it back.
Riverfarm's fields breathe easier, and a witch in the hollow no longer collects on the village's fear.
A merchant's name is settled in Invrisil, one way or another, and the Brothers remember who settled it.
The forge tier of Pallass stands open above you now, papers stamped and the lift unlocked.
The Horns of Hammerad have taken a corner of the inn as their own, and the seal beneath Liscor holds quiet.
The Door's reach has outgrown the map you started with, and you have walked all of it.

acts._comment: Act V, the slot #270 reserved. Every beat here banks INSIDE the act (the act_iii lesson: a beat keyed to its own act's exit gate can never render), and because act_v is last even the resolution beat renders. ONE resolution beat, not three: a per-path beat list would leave two entries permanently pending for every player. SPOILER DISCIPLINE: journal.gd renders PENDING act beats in full, marked '·' instead of '✓', so every line here is visible from the moment Act V opens -- none may state more than the act's own title, and nothing names what the vault holds.
acts.title: What the Seal Was Feeding
acts.header: Act V -- What the Seal Was Feeding

beats.text: Pisces will not read it out of a treatise. You are taking him down to it.
You read the seal under Liscor yourself, in the dark, and it was never a lock at all.
You settled what the seal was feeding, and the city goes on not knowing.
